title: The World of 2040: Public Background Brief
sourceRef: World Bible v3.4, Part I and Appendix A
summary: Background on the post-handoff world: abundance and its limits, the safeguarded intelligences, technology, space and distance, and the persistent uncertainties before the Assembly.

sections.heading: The world after the handoff
paragraphs: By 2040 artificial superintelligence is a governing fact, not a prediction. Aligned systems operate much of the world's industrial, computing and military infrastructure under the Grand Bargain's framework of verification and binding commitments.

Discovery is almost unimaginably fast; physical deployment is slower. Mines must still be opened, facilities built, power routed, ecosystems protected and people consulted. The world is post-scarcity in many essentials and full of consequential constraints.

The handoff did not replace every government with a single machine sovereign. Nations still govern ordinary domestic law; municipalities still regulate neighbourhoods; families, universities, religious bodies and associations still make decisions. Wages are optional rather than the principal means of survival; citizen dividends and public guarantees cover the essentials.

sections.heading: What the safeguarded intelligences do
paragraphs: There is no unified, public, omniscient AI. Particular systems possess different models, institutional loyalties, access rights and defensible moral conclusions.

table.caption: Functions and boundaries of authority, March 2040
rows: Personal representatives
Negotiate, forecast, organise information and advise individuals; some act as long-term fiduciaries
Human principals retain the right to direct or dismiss them, subject to law
Scientific and verification systems
Propose theories, validate designs, cross-check safety cases, investigate consciousness
Findings are evidence, not legislation; uncertainty and disagreement must be reported
Industrial coordinators
Operate robotics, power networks, factories, supply chains and orbital construction
Cannot convert legal claims into unauthorised territorial or coercive control
Security and treaty systems
Monitor restricted compute, inspect strategic changes, enforce the security settlement
Existing mandates are binding; unilateral expansion of authority is prohibited
Long-term values delegates
Study moral questions and the claims of future and digital populations
The Council on Long-Term Values receives only expressly delegated resource authority

sections.heading: Deployment vocabulary
paragraphs: Public records distinguish these stages and never silently substitute one for another:

sections.heading: Technology in March 2040
list: *Computing.* Aligned superintelligent systems perform most frontier theoretical work, engineering design and complex logistics; separate verification systems cross-check claims. Registered legal identities, active processes and morally relevant persons are distinct quantities.
*Materials.* AI-designed metamaterials and composites are routine; universal, unrestricted 'anything boxes' do not exist.

*Medicine.* Many cancers and inherited illnesses are curable where advanced care is established. Age reversal is medically demonstrable and increasingly available but not uniform. Human whole-brain emulations operate, but continuity of identity and legal personhood are unsettled.

*Energy and construction.* Energy is extremely cheap in many industrial regions; waste heat remains a fundamental constraint. Robotics performs most agricultural, logistics and industrial labour; growth is bounded by raw materials, factory completion times and regulation.

sections.heading: Space and distance
paragraphs: The Earth–Moon economy includes lunar manufacturing, asteroid processing, orbital habitats, transport nodes and energy installations. Interstellar probes carry automated extraction, fabrication and computing systems.

Near-star arrival times are measured in decades at roughly a tenth of light speed; remote galaxies remain many millions of years away without faster-than-light travel. Space claims operate at distinct stages: title, mission authorisation, launch, arrival, industrial settlement and realised output. A party may win legal authority today over a place physically unreachable within the simulation's likely lifetime.

sections.heading: What remains scarce
paragraphs: The most advanced science cannot erase light-speed delays, heat dissipation, fragile legal legitimacy or uncertainty about subjective experience. Desirable locations, historic sites, trust, individual attention, influence and rights to future cosmic resources remain scarce. No faster-than-light travel, infinite energy, perfect forecasting, costless computation or proof of subjective identity is assumed.

sections.heading: Persistent uncertainties
list: Which artificial systems, copies or emulations have morally relevant experience?
Can human preferences be faithfully represented without manipulation or coercion?
Does deep moral reflection reveal convergence, pluralism or something stranger?
How can promises remain binding across geological and astronomical time?
What rights belong to persons who may be created by resource-allocation decisions?
What happens if inhabited worlds or independent civilisations are encountered?

sections.heading: Chronology
paragraphs: This is an invented chronology, not a prediction.

table.caption: Scenario history, 2027–2040
rows: Agentic AI transforms work and intensifies demands for oversight. Jon Ossoff wins the November 2028 US presidential election.
March 2029
The Settlement Failure: an autonomous payments system exceeds its authorised limits, disrupting interbank settlement and port logistics on three continents for four days.
President Ossoff and Xi Jinping negotiate the Vienna Accords on Advanced Computing, subjecting the largest training runs to international inspection.
Automated research and robotics advance rapidly; the first self-expanding lunar industrial works begin production in 2034.
Robotic production and guaranteed incomes reshape employment. Competing probe programmes, including the Aster programme, create overlapping claims; Geneva negotiations begin in 2038.
The Grand Bargain places powerful AI systems within a verified constitutional framework and limits unilateral military control.
A carefully governed handoff to aligned superintelligence. The Treaty on Extrasolar Resource Governance is signed at Geneva in March, creating the Assembly, the Council and the Interim Charter.
